parameters.name: ClientInstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the ECS or ECI instance to attach.

parameters.name: EiInstanceId
parameters.description: The EAIS instance ID. If this parameter is not set, the system automatically queries for attachable instances under your account that meet the conditions and selects the first queried instance for attachment.

parameters.name: EiInstanceType
parameters.description:
The specifications of the EAIS instance. When the `EiInstanceId` parameter is not specified, set this parameter to limit the specifications of the attached EAIS instance. If the `EiInstanceId` parameter is specified, this parameter does not take effect. Valid values:

- eais.ei-a6.4xlarge

- eais.ei-a6.2xlarge

- eais.ei-a6.xlarge

- eais.ei-a6.large

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the instance.
